sentences.text:
The present petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quashment of the FIR being C.R. No.I-6 of 2017 registered with Gandhinagar Mahila Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code,
as well as under Sections 3, 4 and 7 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing, learned advocate for the petitioner remained absent;
however, learned advocate for the respondent No.2-original complainant was present before this Court.

3. Learned advocate for the respondent No.2, in her characteristic fairness, submitted that subsequent to the registration of the FIR, an amicable settlement was arrived at between the parties through the intervention of family elders and societal mediators.

It is further submitted that the Avinash Hiragir Gosai vs State Of Gujarat on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98349705/
1 complainant and her husband have, by mutual consent, decided to part ways and have instituted Family Suit No.23 NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/542/2018 ORDER DATED: 04/11/2025 undefined of 2025 under Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, before the learned Family Court, Gandhinagar.

entities.text: Avinash Hiragir Gosai vs State Of Gujarat on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said matrimonial proceedings culminated in a decree of divorce dated 25.04.2025, thereby formally ending their matrimonial bond.

4. In light of the above development, learned advocate for the respondent No.2 submitted that the complainant is no longer desirous of prosecuting the FIR or continuing with the criminal proceedings against the petitioner.

5. Recording the fair and candid statement made on behalf of the complainant, and having regard to the fact that the matrimonial relationship between the parties stands dissolved by a decree of competent Court, further continuation of the criminal proceedings would serve no fruitful purpose and would, in fact, operate counterproductive to the spirit of settlement.
6.
Accordingly, the petition deserves consideration and is hereby ALLOWED.

The FIR being C.R.
No.I-6 of 2017 registered with Gandhinagar Mahila Police Station, together with all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, stands quashed and set aside.
